node.title: KoalaBear active balanced-core certificates to order-32 adapter
node.closure: same-owner finite-subset transport into upstream v4 relative classification
node.statement: For every deployed KoalaBear received line, the canonical active balanced-core certificate selector transports Z_BC into the exact input of the upstream partial relative order-32 theorem. If |Z_BC|<=31 it already fits the theorem's exceptional cardinality threshold. Otherwise every 32-subset consists of distinct bad slopes on the same received line with explicit explaining data and exact agreement supports; maximal agreement sets and the stored m-subsupports satisfy the theorem's support normalization. Applying the harvested theorem preserves line and slope labels and yields its affine/rational/near-sunflower or primitive-spread alternatives. This supplies no S, A, E payment and does not imply the legacy Q6 endpoint realization.
